entry.title: What do Connecticut households earn compared with the rest of the country?
entry.summary: Connecticut's median household income is $96,049 (2024), the 11th-highest of 52 peers.

entry.title: Which Connecticut town has the highest property tax rate?
entry.summary: In fiscal year 2027, Hartford taxes real property at 69.95 mills, 2.6 times the 26.66-mill rate that property pays statewide across 168 towns.

entry.title: Which Connecticut towns grew their property tax base fastest?
entry.summary: Bridgeport added $4.85B of net taxable property in 2025 (+59.9%), the fastest growth of 169 towns.

entry.title: How many Connecticut residents live below the poverty line compared with the rest of the country?
entry.summary: 10.2% of Connecticut residents live below the poverty line (2024), the 15th-lowest of 52 peers.

entry.title: How expensive is renting in Connecticut compared to the rest of America?
entry.summary: Connecticut's median gross rent was $1,550 in 2024, the 17th-highest of 52 peers.

entry.title: Are Connecticut homes expensive by national standards?
entry.summary: The median Connecticut home is worth $396,900 (2024), the 19th-highest of 52 peers.
